description: Controlled vocabulary values for the OpenERA research administration platform

value_groups.description: Types of contact information for persons and organizations
Classification of sponsoring and partner organizations
Roles of personnel on sponsored research projects

values.Label: Principal Investigator
values.Description: Lead researcher responsible for the project

values.Label: Senior Personnel
values.Description: Senior researcher contributing significantly to the project

values.Label: Other Professional
values.Description: Professional staff contributing to the project

value_groups.description: Lifecycle status of a grant proposal through the review and submission process

values.Label: Draft
values.Description: Proposal is being prepared by the PI

values.Label: Department Review
values.Description: Under review by the department chair or head

values.Label: College Review
values.Description: Under review by the college dean or designee

values.Label: OSP Review
values.Description: Under review by the Office of Sponsored Programs

values.Label: Submitted
values.Description: Proposal has been submitted to the sponsor

values.Label: Awarded
values.Description: Proposal has been funded by the sponsor

values.Label: Declined
values.Description: Proposal was not selected for funding

values.Label: Withdrawn
values.Description: Proposal was withdrawn before or after submission

value_groups.description: Budget account categories for sponsored project financial management

values.Label: Participant Support
values.Description: Stipends, travel, and subsistence for project participants

values.Label: Subaward
values.Description: Subcontract or subaward to another institution

value_groups.description: Types of regulatory compliance requirements for sponsored research

values.Label: Human Subjects
values.Description: Institutional Review Board approval for human subjects research

values.Label: Animal Subjects
values.Description: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee approval

values.Label: Biosafety
values.Description: Institutional Biosafety Committee approval for biohazards

values.Label: Export Control
values.Description: Export control review for restricted technologies or data

values.Label: Conflict of Interest
values.Description: Financial conflict of interest disclosure and management

values.Label: Responsible Conduct
values.Description: Responsible conduct of research training requirements

values.Label: Data Management
values.Description: Data management and sharing plan requirements

value_groups.description: Types of documents included in a proposal submission package

values.Label: Proposal Narrative
values.Description: Main proposal document describing the research plan

values.Label: Budget Justification
values.Description: Narrative justification for each budget category

values.Label: Facilities
values.Description: Description of facilities, equipment, and resources

values.Label: Data Management Plan
values.Description: Plan for managing and sharing research data

values.Label: Letter of Support
values.Description: Letters of support or commitment from collaborators

values.Label: Returned
values.Description: Request has been returned for revision

values.Label: Not Required
values.Description: Approval is not required for this item

values.Label: Modified Total Direct Cost
values.Description: Standard federal indirect cost rate base excluding equipment, patient care, and subaward amounts over $25K

values.Label: Total Direct Cost
values.Description: Indirect cost rate applied to all direct costs

values.Label: Salary and Wages
values.Description: Indirect cost rate applied only to salary and wage base
